table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	source=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=theader.sgcode),
	target=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=theader.dgcode),
	theader.transcode, 
	theader.date, 
	theader.posted, 
	postedBy = (SELECT Users.UserName FROM Users WHERE Users.UserCode=theader.postedBy),
	qty=sum(tdetail.qty), 
	theader.sgcode, 
	theader.dgcode, 
	item.name,  
	item.customicode 
FROM item,tdetail,theader
WHERE theader.date>=:adt_sdate and 
	theader.date<=:adt_ldate and
	/* theader.posted='Y' and*/
	theader.transcode=tdetail.transcode and
	tdetail.icode=item.icode 
group by theader.transcode,
	item.name,
	item.customicode,
	theader.posted,
	theader.postedBy,
	theader.sgcode,
	theader.dgcode,
	theader.date
ORDER BY  
	theader.date,
	theader.transcode
